Everything in one bench

You will learn

What an integration bench checks when every bus of the design is driven at once.

An integration bench drives every bus at once and asks the design to hold together: test_reset_all_modules, test_module_count, test_mac_uart_pipeline, test_spi_memory_pipeline, test_full_pipeline, seven tests. The recording lowers the integration testbench spec to Verilog: every bus of the design in one bench.

Try it

In the recording, find the five pipeline tests; then in the spec frame say which two buses the integration bench joins.
